title: Overhead Triceps Extension Machine
summary: A machine triceps extension with your arms overhead, which stretches the long head of the triceps.

equipment_needs.text: Needs: commercial gym machine (this exercise's own machine).

muscles.why: Library rating 1 for triceps (main mover): each working set adds 1 of a set to the weekly triceps total.

setup.text: Sit with your upper arms overhead on the pad and grip the handles behind your head.
Extend your arms until they are straight.
Lower slowly until your elbows are fully bent.

form_cues.cue: Keep your elbows pointed forward, not out to the sides.

mistakes.text: Moving the upper arms to help press.

lower_risk.text: Warm-up: the app adds no ramp-up sets; make the first working set a touch lighter if you like.
The app suggests a heavier load only when the jump is 10% or less; otherwise it adds a rep first.
Default target: 10-15 reps, stopping about 2 reps short of failure (RIR 2). Stop the set when form breaks down.
Use the same controlled range on every rep; lower under control rather than dropping or bouncing.
Pick a variation and range you can train pain-free.

alternatives.why: Swap sheet: Less stretch emphasis, Less triceps long-head bias, Peak-contraction focus.

notes: Ratings, swap attributes and cues are the library model (modeled). An authored page will replace this one.
